hero.headline: Building Lending Products from Zero to $40M
hero.hook: I build financial products that grow the business and still leave customers better off.

relevance.statement: I've spent nine years in consumer lending and banking, from launching new loan brands to rebuilding the application that feeds them. At Harbor Street we lifted conversion 6% by fixing dozens of small problems we found in session replays, and cut third-party fraud 85% without adding friction for real applicants.

achievement.context: Launched and grew 3 lending brands at Brightwater
With no measurable drop in completed applications
Through behavioral analytics and steady friction removal

hero.headline: Digital Experiences 400K+ People Use Every Month
hero.hook: Nobody opens a loan app for fun. They want to get it done and get back to their day.

relevance.statement: I led the customer-facing web and app experience for 400K+ monthly users across 5 brands. Most of the wins were small and unglamorous: a confusing field label, a slow vendor iFrame, a button that hid below the fold on older phones. Stacked up over a year, they added up to a 6% lift in conversion.

achievement.context: Owned digital servicing across 5 brands on a shared platform
From months of session replay review and targeted fixes
For display interaction designs validated in field testing

hero.headline: From Boat Helms to Pump Stations: Interfaces That Can't Fail
hero.hook: I've designed screens for people wearing gloves in the rain.

relevance.statement: I spent seven years at Ironvale Machines building displays and controls for diesel engines. On a pump station or a boat helm, a confusing screen isn't an annoyance; it's downtime. We put far more engine data in front of operators than they'd ever had, earned 2 patents for the interaction design, and shipped the first web-based displays in the product line.

achievement.context: Marine, pumping and power generation displays used in harsh conditions
For operator interface designs proven in field trials
HTML and JavaScript interfaces running on the display hardware itself

hero.headline: One Platform, Five Brands, Zero Copy-Paste
hero.hook: Every brand should feel like its own product. None of them should need its own codebase.

relevance.statement: I've owned product for a shared lending platform behind 5 consumer brands and 400K+ monthly users. Each brand has its own look, pricing and states. Underneath, they share one application flow, one servicing portal and one set of internal tools, which is what let us launch a new brand in a quarter instead of a year.

achievement.context: Shared components with brand-level theming and configuration
Moved every customer to a managed identity service with no downtime
Swappable integrations so a vendor outage never took the application down
